notes.note: Reviewed the combined metadata/history integration: both parent source-path/check contributions remain intact. Final UI delta preserves legacy engine-wide activity by default, formats fractional allowance values, separates reused window IDs by label/duration, and disambiguates colliding labels with duration. SDK/HTTP UI tests cover historical series selection, precision, scopes and currencies. Peer receipt parsing now validates optional accountKey type, with valid-preservation and malformed-field transport cases. No billing/routing authority, raw credential exposure or public schema removal is introduced. Independent review verified merged ledger contributions and the final selector repair; native/Nightly delivery remains separate.
